reason: I already paid for a DM tool that got me an action block and almost no replies, so anything that says it sends DMs for me makes me flinch. $147 a month is a lot on $23k a year when I don't have my next client yet, and there are no customer results to look at.
objection: No proof it works and nothing says it won't get my account blocked again. 7 of 100 seats and zero published results tells me I'd be the guinea pig, and a card-required trial that turns into non-refundable payments if I forget on day 4 feels like a trap.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from agency owners or setters at my size, with screenshots of replies and booked calls. Also a plan under $60 with no card needed for the trial, or a refund if my account gets limited.
